text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My name is Seeking the Pearl, and I<n>exist to show
dreams to people<n>around the world and save them
from<n>despair!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now let me show you my moments of<n>glory, from
my consecutive wins in<n>domestic races to my
triumph of<n>becoming the first Umamusume from
Tracen Academy to win a European<n>G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First of all, I have to choose whether I<n>should run
miles and sprints, or take<n>on the Triple Tiara. If I go
with miles<n>and sprints...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The biggest obstacle standing in my<n>way will be
Taiki Shuttle! But the<n>stronger my opponent is, the
more<n>exciting things get!
